entries.365096c084bf5524: The company has a system in which it consistently handles everything from product development to sales, implementation support, and maintenance and support with its own staff. It has agentless technology that records activity by placing a gateway server in between, without installing a small recording program on the target server, which makes it easy to deploy even on servers that handle important data. Maintenance support continues after licenses are deployed, and in the fiscal year ended March 2026 the maintenance renewal rate achieved 96%.

entries.4af831b79be2c5c2: In April 2024, the company established its purpose, 'Creating a society where everyone can use IT with peace of mind', and its long-term vision 'VISION2030'. VISION2030 states that the company will create new value in the field of IT system operations management, such as privileged ID management and audit trail management, and that, in addition to a business model centered on products and maintenance, it will fully enter cloud services and expand solutions such as consulting services. The fiscal years from the year ended March 2025 to the year ending March 2027 are positioned as the investment phase of the first medium-term management plan, under which the company is advancing feature enhancements to existing products and the development of new products and cloud services.
